subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps / schedule technical deep dive

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Lee <ethan.lee@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner intro — discovery recap + next steps

Hi Ethan — great speaking earlier with you and Sophie. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

- Discovery highlights: CloudBridge is evaluating an integrated marketplace listing + managed deployment option for customers that need private inference. Key asks were: VPC/on-prem package, marketplace billing integration, and partner co-sell support.
- Technical priorities you mentioned: latency SLAs for 50–100TPS sampling, KMS integration, and model variant pinning for compliance.

Next steps we propose:
1) Schedule a partner-led technical deep dive (60 min) with our infra engineer (Mateo) to go through deployment topology, KMS options, and marketplace integration points.
2) Share a mutual action plan doc and an initial pricing/packaging note.

Camila, Mateo — can you join this thread to propose 2–3 slots next week? Ethan / Sophie — what days/times work best on your side?

I attached a short platform overview and a draft mutual action plan for context.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: RBW-Platform-Overview.pdf (summary), CloudBridge-MutualActionPlan.docx (draft)
